outcome.outcome: Infection control stops depending on infrastructure that low-resource settings do not have, so prevention capability becomes decoupled from a country's health-system budget.
outcome.rationale: Their description frames every deficiency as an infrastructure mismatch rather than a missing scientific result.

ai_types.rationale: Cost-constrained design of antimicrobial materials, PPE and sanitation is a search under an explicit cost objective.
Vaccine distribution and decentralised production are logistics and allocation problems, not technical ones.

measurability.rationale: Cost per unit, coverage achieved and infection rates in served populations are all routinely reported by health systems.

outcome.outcome: Cause of disease becomes identifiable at the point of care rather than inferred from syndrome, so available treatments actually reach the patients they would help.
outcome.rationale: Their description names the specific loss: tests that do not reveal cause delay or prevent administration of treatments that already exist.

ai_types.rationale: Multiplexed point-of-care readout and volatilomics are detection problems where learned signal extraction lifts sensitivity at fixed hardware cost.

measurability.rationale: Sensitivity, specificity, cost per test and time to result are the standard diagnostic metrics.

outcome.outcome: Diseases that have resisted vaccines for decades, tuberculosis and Group A Streptococcus among them, get effective countermeasures, and malnutrition's developmental mechanism becomes a design target.
outcome.rationale: Their description names the specific pathogens and adds the basic science of malnutrition as a prerequisite for better intervention.

ai_types.rationale: Immunogen design against hard targets is the core of their vaccine capability and is where generative design applies most directly.
These are under-provisioned rather than undiscoverable; the market failure is well understood and pull mechanisms already exist.

measurability.rationale: Vaccine efficacy in trial, disease incidence and cost per course are direct and long-tracked quantities.

notes: All three tier-1. Global health gaps are unusually well instrumented because the outcome is a health statistic someone already collects.
